paite: Ngai in, a ni a hongtun jiakin, meipi bangin a kuanga; huchiin kisatheite tengteng, gilou nasemte tengteng, buhpawl hi ding uh; huan a hongtung huai niin amaute a kang mang ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, zung leh hiang leng nutsiat kei hial ding hi.
english: “For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble; and the day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

paite: Ahihhangin nou ka min kihtate kiangah diktatna ni, a khatea hihdamna toh a hongsuak ding; huchiin na pawt khe ding ua, huangsung bawngnoute bangin na diang velhvelh ding uh.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap like calves of the stall.

paite: Huan giloute na sik den ding ua; ka gamtat ni chiangin na khepek nuai uah meivu ahi ding uh a hih jiakin, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Horeba Israel tengteng adinga ka sikha Mosi dan, amah thupiak, thusehte leh vaihawmte ngei tuh, theigige un.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA ni thupi leh mulkimhuai a hongtun maiin jawlnei Elija na kiang uah ka honsawl ding.Huan, pate lungtang tate lamah, tate lungtang a pate uh lam ah a nga sak ding; huchilouin jaw hamsiain lei ka honggawt kha ding.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Huan, pate lungtang tate lamah, tate lungtang a pate uh lam ah a nga sak ding; huchilouin jaw hamsiain lei ka honggawt kha ding.
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”
